title: Step 5 - Sentiment Analysis Data Cleaning: Removing Numbers with TM Map

cues.en: Voiceover: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 旁白：大家好，歡迎來到 R 教學。

cues.en: So now in this new step of the cleaning process we will remove all the punctuations in the reviews of the corpus.
cues.zh: 這個新清理步驟，移除語料庫評論的全部標點。

cues.en: And it's going to be as simple as before.
cues.zh: 和之前一樣簡單。

cues.en: We will copy this line, paste it below, and instead of remove numbers here, we will input remove punctuation, as simple as that.
cues.zh: 複製這行貼下來，把 removeNumbers 改 removePunctuation，就這樣。

cues.en: We don't need anything else, and that's ready to remove any punctuation in all the reviews of the corpus.
cues.zh: 不用其他，準備移除所有評論標點。

cues.en: All right, so let's check it out.
cues.zh: 檢查。

cues.en: We can actually check it out with the first review well, "... love this place".
cues.zh: 可以用第一則「wow... love this place」。

cues.en: And so what we're supposed to obtain after applying this remove punctuation function on all the reviews of the corpus through the tmap function well, the three little dots are supposed to disappear.
cues.zh: 透過 tm_map 套 removePunctuation 後，三個點應該消失。

cues.en: All right, so let's check it out.
cues.zh: 來檢查。

cues.en: So remember in the actual version of the corpus right now the first review is, "wow... love this place".
cues.zh: 記得目前第一則是 wow... love this place。

cues.en: So now let's select this new line of code, execute.
cues.zh: 選新行，執行。

cues.en: New corpus of reviews created with all the punctuation removed.
cues.zh: 已建立移除標點的新語料庫。

cues.en: So let's go back to the console, and let's press the up arrow to get the line of code that is giving us access to the first review.
cues.zh: 回主控台，向上取得存取第一則的程式碼。

cues.en: Here it is.
cues.zh: 來了。

cues.en: So let's press enter now.
cues.zh: 按 Enter。

cues.en: And as you can see, the three little dots disappeared.
cues.zh: 可以看到三個點消失。

cues.en: Therefore, that's exactly what the remove punctuation function does here.
cues.zh: 正是 removePunctuation 的作用。

cues.en: It removes any kind of punctuation including dots, commas, colons, semicolons or any other kind of punctuation.
cues.zh: 移除任何標點，包括點、逗號、冒號、分號或其他。

cues.en: All right, so next step done.
cues.zh: 這步完成。

cues.en: We are ready to move on to the next step which will be to remove all the non-relevant words in the reviews.
cues.zh: 下一步移除評論所有無關詞。

cues.en: So for example, if we have a look at this first review here, well, this is not very relevant.
cues.zh: 例如第一則的 this，不太相關。

cues.en: You know, this doesn't give any hint on knowing whether the review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 不提供正負線索。

cues.en: So this is typically a word that we don't want to have in the final sparse matrix because this is not relevant.
cues.zh: 典型不希望在最終矩陣的詞，因為無關。

cues.en: So we will remove it in the next step of the cleaning process, and we'll do the same for all the other words of the same kind.
cues.zh: 下一清理步驟移除，也對其他同類詞做一樣的事。

cues.en: So let's do that in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 下一堂來做。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
